brief.title: Flutter Developer at Nuqta Labs
brief.instructions: Ask about state management and testing.

documents.title: Job description
documents.text: Flutter developer, Lahore, hybrid (three office days a week). Dart, Flutter, Bloc, Firebase, REST APIs. Writes widget tests. Works with two designers.

documents.title: CV
documents.text: Ayesha Siddiqui. Flutter developer, 3 years. Ghar Dekho, Lahore: property listing app, 100,000 downloads, rating 4.6.

answers: At Ghar Dekho I built the listing app in Flutter with Bloc.
I write widget tests for every screen.
